newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Azucarera de Pilar to become holding firm.
newsitem.headline: Azucarera de Pilar to become holding firm.

text.p: Sugar refiner Central Azucarera de Pilar said on Friday its board of directors had approved the conversion of the company into an investment holding concern.

In the same notice to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the company also said its board had proposed to acquire all the outstanding shares of Philippine Gaming Management Corp (PGMC) through the issuance of new company shares in exchange for PGMC shares.
PGMC owns the equipment leased by the state Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office which runs a lottery on the main island of Luzon.
A special meeting of the company's stockholders has been scheduled on October 16 to vote on the board's proposals, the notice said.
